sections.Profile:
"Falstaff" is a four-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in October 1957.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1957
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 4
- Tags: Fictional Character, Wood Rail, Original Theme
